# FG-WEB-0012

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 404 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`cli-distribution`](../../ops/runbooks/cli-distribution.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_unknown_or_absent_target_is_404` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この環境向けの gstn はこのサーバーで配布していません。設定画面の「CLI（gstn）をダウンロード」で配布中のものを確認してください。
- en: This server does not distribute gstn for that platform. See "Download the CLI (gstn)" in the settings for the available ones.
- id: Server ini tidak menyediakan gstn untuk platform tersebut. Lihat "Unduh CLI (gstn)" di pengaturan untuk yang tersedia.

## 原因 (cause)

`GET /api/v1/clients/gstn/{target}/binary` named a target that is not one of the known ones (`windows-x86_64`, `linux-x86_64`), or a known target that this installation does not ship: the client directory (`clients.dir`, default `<install>/share/forge/clients`) has no manifest entry for it, or the entry's file is missing. The listing `GET /api/v1/clients` omits such targets.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason` (`unknown_target` with `target` cut to 32 characters, `not_in_manifest`, `no_manifest`, `file_missing`) and `target`. On the server (read-only): list the client directory and read its `manifest.json` (runbook cli-distribution).

## 対処 (fix)

The caller picks a target the listing shows. If a target should be shipped, the image build (ops/gitlab-trial/Dockerfile, stage `gstn`) must produce it; redeploy an image that contains it (runbook cli-distribution).
